name: ruletka
summary: Open-source stranger video chat: WebRTC P2P media, multi-hub matchmaking, friends, safety tools.
description: Chat roulette with peer-to-peer camera/mic. Matchmaking via roulette-bridge hubs (public directory + optional federation). Freenet lobby/session contracts remain available as a research path.
